blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Tereza Valentova – Hong Kong Open Round of 16 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala scored a breakthrough 6-4, 7-6 (7) win over Tereza Valentova of Czech Republic to advance to the 2026 quarterfinals of the Hong Kong Tennis Open. After losing to Valentova in straight sets in their first two meetings, Eala finally got one over the world No. 85 but needed to dig deep, especially in the tiebreak, to come away with the Round of 16 victory. “I had to fight.
